scope: F03 annotation workflow implementation and automated correctness. Native UI visual acceptance remains separate.
implementation: Nine local anchor positions and exact percentages with an actual scene preview, target replacement and world detachment
Independent saved text labels with exact x/y and existing canvas drag handles
Deleted, cropped, replaced, relinked, explicit-review and unverified-original states
Group statuses, numbered markers, appearance presets and existing native library style save/apply
Root reservation, post-reservation source and permission checks, strict-base journal dispatch and author Undo/Redo
Independent annotation group remapping for duplicate, clipboard, library and experiment keep-both

includes: Malformed anchors, statuses, metadata and unknown-field refusal
Actual temporary SQLite save, connection close, reopen, author Undo and Redo of anchors, label geometry and status

limits: An older image original without a valid SHA256 remains explicitly unverified. Replacing it with same-sized content cannot be conclusively identified from dimensions alone.
The source fingerprint contains stable content/crop/source metadata, never local asset or attachment IDs. It is review metadata and grants no source access rights.
Legacy finite UV positions just outside a stroke's geometry are retained without endpoint jumps. The explicit anchor picker chooses positions within zero to one.
The legacy global Annotations group is retained as saved. Newly drawn arrows receive independent group IDs.
Dialogs reject any intervening scene change conservatively, including unrelated edits. Reopening is required.
No browser/native light, dark or RTL visual acceptance is claimed by this artifact. No owner database, installation or deployment was changed.
